create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
create_scheduler_config: create a SchedulerConfig dataclass to configure local or SLURM scheduling with node and array job counts
create_slurm_config: create a SlurmConfig dataclass to set SLURM job parameters like memory, timeout, CPUs, and partition
review_jobconfig_post_init: review the JobConfig __post_init__ method that auto-generates Metadata with log, checkpoint, and results directories
create_scheduler_type_enum: create a SchedulerType enum with LOCAL and SLURM values for selecting the job scheduler mode
